rules_subtitle: Respect, professionalism and constructiveness are the foundation of our platform
principle_1: Be polite and respect other participants.
prohibited_1: Insults, rudeness, aggression in any form.
prohibited_2: Spam, advertising, links to third-party resources without permission.
prohibited_3: Publishing personal information of other people without their consent.
prohibited_5: Copyright infringement — copying other people's answers without attribution.
prohibited_6: Repeated duplication of questions and answers.
creating_questions_1: Formulate the title clearly and to the point.
creating_questions_2: Describe the problem in detail, provide context.
creating_questions_3: Add relevant tags for proper categorization.
creating_questions_4: Do not ask questions that have already been asked — use the search first.
creating_questions_5: Questions that violate Russian legislation are prohibited.
writing_answers_1: Answer the question directly, do not go off-topic.
writing_answers_2: Argue your point of view, give examples.
writing_answers_3: Do not publish answers that contain only links — add an explanation.
writing_answers_4: If you made a mistake — correct the answer or point out the error in a comment.
voting_rules_1: Vote for useful and high-quality answers.
voting_rules_2: Do not vote for your own questions/answers.
voting_rules_3: Do not organize vote manipulation — this will lead to blocking.
file_attachments_1: Only safe formats are allowed: images, video, audio, documents, archives.
file_attachments_2: Executable files (.exe, .bat, .sh, etc.) are strictly prohibited.
file_attachments_4: Do not upload files containing viruses or malicious code.
tags_rules_1: Use only relevant tags, do not abuse popular ones.
tags_rules_3: Tag length — no more than 20 characters.
tags_rules_4: Tags containing profanity or insults are prohibited.
tags_rules_5: Autocomplete is available when entering tags — use it for convenience.
profile_rules_1: Nickname should not contain insults or provocative words.
profile_rules_2: Avatar should not violate the law or contain inappropriate content.
profile_rules_3: Email is visible only to you — the administration does not share it with third parties.
profile_rules_4: You can add information about yourself in your profile.
profile_rules_5: Registration is possible only with email addresses in the .ru domain.
editing_rules_1: You can edit your questions and answers at any time.
editing_rules_2: When editing, you cannot leave fields empty.
editing_rules_3: Change history is not saved, but the administration can see previous versions.

mission_subtitle: Connecting students and professionals for career growth
what_we_do_text: CareerVibe is a platform where students and young professionals can ask questions to professionals from leading companies and get quality answers. We believe that everyone has the right to free career advice.
our_goal_text: To help thousands of students find their path, develop skills and achieve success in the financial and IT sectors. We create a community based on mutual assistance and expertise.
value_mutual_help_text: We believe that sharing knowledge makes us stronger. Every question is an opportunity for growth.
value_expertise_text: Our experts are professionals from leading companies, ready to share real experience.
value_development_text: We create an environment where everyone can develop, learn and find their career path.
value_accessibility_text: Career advice should be available to everyone. We make it free.
join_us_text: Ask a question, answer someone else's question, or just read useful discussions. Together we build a bridge between education and real career.
